description: Kraus Hamdani Aerospace | Software Engineer | REMOTE (US) or ONSITE in Reno, NV We build long-endurance autonomous aircraft and the software used to operate them. Looking for a strong generalist software engineer. Most application work is TypeScript/web, with C/C++ and Rust elsewhere in the stack. You’ll work across frontend, backend, cloud, DevOps, and directly with flight test and hardware teams. We care a lot about code quality, maintainability, and engineers who can take ambiguous problems and independently ship solid software. No sloppers. U.S. defense/security eligibility required. Apply: software@khaero.com
